explication: HunyuanImage-3.0 is a multimodal image-generation model with text-to-image and instruction-guided image editing. Users submit prompts (and optionally images) through command-line inference or the Gradio chatbot; the application prepares model inputs, runs autoregressive generation and image decoding, then returns text or images. Prompt enhancement through Tencent Cloud and vLLM serving are separate capabilities. Internal model components are shown where source references support them; unsampled implementation details and uncertain connections are omitted.
